skill.summary: Comprehensive UI design skill covering fundamentals, patterns, and anti-patterns. Layout, typography, color, spacing, accessibility, motion, and component design. Use when building any web interface, reviewing design quality, or creating distinctive UIs.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the UI Design skill, providing a comprehensive guide to web interface design.
- Covers fundamentals: layout, typography, color, spacing, accessibility, motion, and component design.
- Includes practical design philosophies, patterns, and common anti-patterns for high-quality, distinctive UIs.
- Offers clear guidelines and code examples for implementing grids, responsive design, typography scales, palette building, and spacing systems.
- Emphasizes accessibility and visual hierarchy for production-ready web projects.
